column2: The historian examined the role of elders in a patriarchic family structure.
column3: 历史学家研究了长辈在族长制家庭结构中的作用。
column5: 族长制结构；较少见，现代讨论也常用 patriarchal

column2: The professor announced that all assignments would henceforth be submitted online.
column3: 教授宣布，从此以后所有作业都要在线提交。
column5: 从此以后提交；henceforth 较正式

column2: The character refuses to grovel for approval from the wealthy family.
column3: 这个人物拒绝为了获得富裕家庭的认可而卑躬屈膝。
column5: 卑躬屈膝地乞求认可；带贬义

column2: A vivid story can spellbind an audience during a lecture.
column3: 一个生动的故事可以在讲座中深深吸引听众。
column5: 使听众着迷；过去式、过去分词为 spellbound

column2: The instructor asked the student to enunciate each word clearly during the presentation.
column3: 指导老师要求学生在演讲时把每个单词都发音清楚。
column5: 清晰地说出单词；也可指阐明观点

column2: The researcher noticed a recurring pattern in the observations.
column3: 研究者注意到观察结果中有一个反复出现的模式。
column5: 反复出现的模式

column2: The geology class examined a piece of limestone from the field site.
column3: 地质学课检查了一块来自野外考察地点的石灰石。
column5: 石灰岩地层或构造

column2: The history lecture described how a wagon carried supplies across the plains.
column3: 历史讲座描述了四轮马车如何穿越平原运送物资。
column5: 篷车；常用于历史叙述

column2: The researchers plan to deploy sensors at several points along the river.
column3: 研究者计划在河流沿线的几个地点部署传感器。
column5: 部署传感器；也可表示部署人员或军队

column2: The student drew a daisy while observing plants in the campus garden.
column3: 这名学生在校园花园观察植物时画了一朵雏菊。
column5: 一朵雏菊；复数 daisies

column2: The textbook includes a sidebar explaining the origin of the term.
column3: 这本教科书包含一个说明该术语起源的补充信息栏。
column5: 教科书中的补充信息栏；网页语境也指侧边栏

column2: The laboratory procedure was designed to inactivate the enzyme before measurement.
column3: 这套实验步骤旨在测量前使酶失活。
column5: 使酶失活；实验室专业用语

column2: Several alumni agreed to donate books to the university library.
column3: 几位校友同意向大学图书馆捐赠图书。
column5: 把某物捐赠给……

column2: The jury decided to acquit the defendant because the evidence was insufficient.
column3: 由于证据不足，陪审团决定宣告被告无罪。
column5: 宣告某人所受某项指控不成立；法律语境用法

column2: The researchers emphasized the paucity of reliable data about the region.
column3: 研究者强调了有关该地区的可靠数据十分匮乏。
column5: ……的匮乏；较正式

column2: The psychology seminar discussed an ideomotor movement that occurred without conscious planning.
column3: 心理学研讨会讨论了一种没有经过有意识计划的观念运动。
column5: 观念运动；心理学专业用语

column2: After further discussion, the committee agreed to accede to the students' request.
column3: 进一步讨论之后，委员会同意接受学生们的请求。
column5: 同意或接受请求；较正式，不直接接宾语

column2: The project leader tried to enlist the help of local volunteers.
column3: 项目负责人试图争取当地志愿者的帮助。
column5: 争取……的帮助；也可表示参军或招募

column2: The university plans to publicize the lecture through its student newsletter.
column3: 大学计划通过学生通讯来宣传这场讲座。
column5: 宣传一项活动；及物动词

column2: The experiment ran smoothly after the team corrected the equipment problem.
column3: 团队解决设备问题之后，实验进行得很顺利。
column5: 顺利进行；副词修饰动词

column2: The new method may accelerate the collection of research data.
column3: 新方法可能加快研究数据的收集。
column5: 加快某个过程；及物或不及物动词

column2: The neuroscience lecture examined how activity in the cortex relates to perception.
column3: 神经科学讲座探讨了皮层活动如何与感知相关。
column5: 大脑皮层

column2: Mineral deposits can encrust the inside of a pipe over time.
column3: 随着时间推移，矿物沉积物可能在管道内壁形成硬壳。
column5: 表面覆盖或结满……

column2: A rancher described how changes in rainfall affected the pasture.
column3: 一位牧场主描述了降雨变化如何影响牧场。
column5: 养牛的牧场主；主要用于北美语境

column2: The literature class compared the formal diction of one poem with the conversational language of another.
column3: 文学课比较了一首诗的正式措辞与另一首诗的口语化语言。
column5: 正式措辞；文学和语言分析用语

column2: The professor emphasized that environmental stress can affect the growth of plants.
column3: 教授强调，环境压力可能影响植物的生长。
column5: 环境压力；动词搭配 stress the importance of 表示强调……的重要性

column2: Students need time to digest the complex information presented in the lecture.
column3: 学生需要时间来理解和吸收讲座中呈现的复杂信息。
column5: 理解、吸收信息；也可表示消化食物

column2: Accurate measurements are essential to the success of the experiment.
column3: 准确的测量对于实验的成功至关重要。
column5: 对……必不可少；也可用 it is essential that 引导从句

column2: A quiet study space is conducive to concentration.
column3: 安静的学习空间有助于集中注意力。
column5: 有助于……；to 是介词，后接名词或动名词

column2: The biology lecture focused on the role of the pancreas in the digestive system.
column3: 生物学讲座重点介绍了胰腺在消化系统中的作用。
column5: 胰腺；器官名称，在具体语境中常带 the

column2: The art historian pointed out the tall windows in the Gothic cathedral.
column3: 艺术史学家指出了这座哥特式大教堂中的高大窗户。
column5: 哥特式建筑；风格名称通常大写

column2: An undergraduate can apply for the research program after completing the introductory course.
column3: 本科生在完成入门课程后可以申请参加这个研究项目。
column5: 一名本科生；不要与 graduate student（研究生）混淆

column2: The student had a conversation with the professor about the research proposal.
column3: 这名学生就研究计划与教授进行了一次交谈。
column5: 与……交谈；make conversation 表示找话题聊天

column2: The wick carried the liquid fuel to the flame at the top of the lamp.
column3: 灯芯将液体燃料输送到灯顶部的火焰处。
column5: 灯的灯芯；可数名词

column2: The researchers used cameras to study nocturnal animals without disturbing them.
column3: 研究者使用摄像机来研究夜行动物，而不打扰它们。
column5: 夜行动物；与 diurnal（昼行性的）对比

column2: The department uses academic performance as a criterion for selecting scholarship recipients.
column3: 这个系把学业表现作为选择奖学金获得者的一项标准。
column5: ……的一项标准；复数是 criteria

column2: The lecture examined the influence of climate on human settlement.
column3: 讲座探讨了气候对人类定居的影响。
column4: the influence of A on B
column5: A 对 B 的影响；动词 influence 后直接接宾语

column2: Researchers should not attribute every change in the data to the same cause.
column3: 研究者不应把数据中的每一个变化都归因于同一个原因。
column5: 把 A 归因于 B；注意不要误用为 attribute A with B

column2: Changes in land use can contribute to the loss of natural habitats.
column3: 土地利用方式的变化可能导致自然栖息地的丧失。
column5: 促成；有助于；to 是介词，后接名词或动名词

column2: All research proposals must conform to the university's ethical guidelines.
column3: 所有研究计划都必须符合大学的伦理准则。
column5: 符合或遵守……；后接规定、标准等

column2: The discovery of a new fossil provided decisive evidence for the scientist's theory.
column3: 一块新化石的发现为这位科学家的理论提供了决定性的证据。
column5: 决定性的证据；decisive 也可描述果断的人或决策

column2: The student observed a bacterial flagellum through the microscope.
column3: 这名学生通过显微镜观察到了细菌的鞭毛。
column5: 细菌的一根鞭毛；flagellum 的复数可为 flagella

column2: The anthropology course examines how a folkway is passed from one generation to the next.
column3: 这门人类学课程考察一种民俗如何代代相传。
column5: 传统民俗；讨论社会习俗时常用复数 folkways

column2: Students complained that the new textbooks were outrageously expensive.
column3: 学生们抱怨新教材贵得离谱。
column5: 贵得离谱；outrageously 修饰形容词，表示程度令人难以接受

column2: The psychology course compares psychoanalysis with other approaches to understanding human behavior.
column3: 这门心理学课程把精神分析与其他理解人类行为的方法进行比较。
column5: 研究精神分析；这是心理学领域的术语

column2: The character's saucy reply reveals her confidence in challenging authority.
column3: 这个人物无礼而俏皮的回答表现出她挑战权威的自信。
column5: 无礼而俏皮的回答；saucy 的具体语气需结合语境判断

column2: The writer's conceit prevented him from accepting useful criticism.
column3: 这位作家的自负使他无法接受有益的批评。
column5: 个人的自负；在文学讨论中 conceit 也可指精巧的比喻

column2: The lecture compared the skeleton of a vertebrate with the body structures of other animals.
column3: 讲座比较了脊椎动物的骨骼与其他动物的身体结构。
column5: 一种脊椎动物；与 invertebrate（无脊椎动物）对比

column2: The students used a microscope to observe the structure of a snowflake.
column3: 学生们用显微镜观察一片雪花的结构。
column5: 一片雪花的结构；snowflake 是可数名词

column2: The horse began to gallop across the open field.
column3: 这匹马开始在开阔的田野上疾驰。
column5: 疾驰穿过田野；gallop 可作动词，也可作名词

column2: The experiment measured the amount of sugar in fresh apple juice.
column3: 这个实验测量了新鲜苹果汁中的糖含量。
column5: 苹果汁；表示果汁时 juice 通常是不可数名词

column2: The museum displayed each accessory alongside the traditional clothing.
column3: 博物馆把每件配饰和传统服装一同展出。
column5: 一件服饰配件；作名词时是可数名词，复数为 accessories

column2: The geologist examined unconsolidated sand near the river bank.
column3: 这位地质学家检查了河岸附近的松散沙土。
column5: 未固结的沉积物；地质语境中指尚未紧密胶结的物质

column2: The research team studied marine organisms living near the coast.
column3: 这个研究团队研究了生活在海岸附近的海洋生物。
column5: 海洋生物；marine 作形容词时表示海洋的，也可指海军的
